#Cardano Launches Smart Contracts on Testnet, Pushing #ADA to New Highs

Smart contracts functionality has been rolled out on Cardano’s testnet, propelling the price of ADA to a new record-high above $3.

#Shiba Inu surges over 45% in two days to reach an all-time high

Shiba Inu ( $SHIB), a spin-off to Dogecoin (DOGE) token, reached an all-time high following a price surge of more than 46% in just two days.

https://t.co/xE4bK1N58z
According to @coingecko, $SHIB Flips $DOGE to Become Tenth-Largest Cryptocurrency. https://t.co/Dlsv7vEBMt

🚨🚨🚨 Coinbase Derivatives delays #DOGE contract launch to April 29.

Coinbase has postponed the launch of Dogecoin (DOGE) futures contracts from April 1st to April 29th after sending letters about the proposed contracts to the CFTC for self-certification.

🔥 BREAKING : Open House Group Co., Ltd., one of Japan’s 🇯🇵 top real estate companies by revenue, has announced that it is now accepting $XRP, $DOGE and $SOL as a payment method for property purchases.

Addition to its previously accepted Bitcoin and Ethereum.
